launch_prometheus_server: launch a prometheus server for metrics collection if one is not already running
launch_grafana_server: launch a grafana server for metrics visualization if one is not already running
launch_servers_and_wait: launch both prometheus and grafana servers and wait in a loop until interrupted
start_metrics_server: start a prometheus metrics HTTP server on port 3031 for the current job
cleanup_metrics: clean up and shut down existing prometheus and grafana servers if they exist
